mainEntity.name: Do you rebuild both V6 and V8 F-Type Coupe engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work on the supercharged 3.0 V6 and 5.0 V8 engines, as well as the 2.0 Ingenium unit, after a full assessment.

mainEntity.name: What does an F-Type Coupe engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the engine type, unit availability and labour required. We provide a quote after assessing your Coupe rather than a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Can you supply an F-Type Coupe reconditioned engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Where replacement is the better option, we can supply and fit a reconditioned engine matched to your Coupe's engine code.

mainEntity.name: Is the AJ126 engine worth rebuilding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, if the core components are in good condition. We inspect the engine first and only recommend a rebuild when it makes practical sense.

mainEntity.name: Does a misfire mean my Coupe needs a rebuild?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. A misfire can come from ignition, fuel or mechanical causes. A diagnostic check is needed before any rebuild is considered.

mainEntity.name: How long does an F-Type Coupe engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the fault, parts availability and machining required. We will give you an estimated timeframe once the engine has been assessed.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my F-Type Coupe from outside Essex?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer collection and delivery across the UK, so you can use our workshop wherever your Coupe is based.
